summary: AtaiBeckley Inc. filed an 8-K updating the status of its pending acquisition by Eli Lilly and Company (Parent) via merger with indirect subsidiary Albali Acquisition Corporation, per the July 15, 2026 Merger Agreement. The HSR waiting period expired August 28, 2026. The UK CMA had no further questions on August 21; the Australian ACCC cleared the merger subject to a 14-day waiting period expiring September 10, 2026. The company will survive as a wholly owned subsidiary. Watch for stockholder approval and any competing offers.
